prompt: Output only SVG code (no explanations, no markdown) for a 600x400 canvas. Draw a 4x4 grid of equal squares on the left half, numbered 1-16 in reading order, and shade exactly the squares that a knight (standard chess L-move) can reach in one move from square 6; add a legend on the right stating the count of shaded squares and listing their numbers. All labels and legend text must be readable and non-overlapping, and the grid must not touch the canvas edges.
